brief.why: Goal 2 of 3: from game launch to the key bindings page, the quickest way, and a picture of every page of it.
brief.start: Recorder running. Press Home, then I start Alan Wake.
move: On every screen that needs a key: Page Down, then that key.
On the key bindings page: Page Down, then the key that scrolls or turns the page, for every page.
brief.end: On the last page of bindings: End. Change no bindings.

setup_notes: Recorded with Tefa 2026-09-29 (three-key recorder): title -> Options -> Controls -> Key Bindings. The list scrolls (21 rows, 10 visible); the route takes three pictures, 10 Downs apart.
